items.title: Final Fantasy artist Yoshitaka Amano explains why AI can't replace human creativity
items.excerpt: Interviewed at Anime Expo about ZAN, his new hand-drawn animated series, legendary Final Fantasy artist Yoshitaka Amano says he sees AI as a tool, not an enemy — but insists 'only humans can create the original,' arguing hand-drawn imperfection matters more than ever in an age of generative art.

items.title: Sega is seemingly letting AI turn its Dreamcast keychains into slop, but the final product could be safe
items.excerpt: Promo images for officially licensed Sega Dreamcast controller keychains appear AI-altered — zooming into the Sega logo reveals vague cursive-shaped lines instead of real letters — the latest case of AI-generated marketing art slipping into licensed game merchandise.

items.title: From prompt to reality: how to turn your idea into a physical 3D-printed collectible using Hi3D
items.excerpt: 80 Level put Hi3D's AI 3D-maker platform through a full pipeline test: from a single text prompt to concept variations, watertight auto-repaired meshes, and a fully assembled, print-ready Space Marine miniature — a working text-to-physical-collectible workflow for game artists.

items.title: Using UE with Image and Video Generation (Coming Soon) | State of Unreal | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
items.excerpt: Epic's State of Unreal session shows how Unreal Engine tools used in tandem with image and video generation models let artists direct generative output with 'greater intention and creative control' — an official look at how genAI plugs into the UE art pipeline, coming soon.

items.title: Unreal Engine 6 | State of Unreal | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
items.excerpt: Epic's official Unreal Engine 6 vision video: UE6 is pitched as evolving how games are shipped and operated — better rendering, faster cook times, and deep AI-assisted workflows baked into the engine. Note: the UE6 announcement itself dates to the Jun 17-18 State of Unreal show (this official video posted Jun 24); dev backlash to its AI features was covered by Aftermath on Jun 17 (outside window).

items.title: Spend less time on scene setup with Unity AI
items.excerpt: New official Unity short demos Unity AI (Beta) automating scene setup so developers spend more time iterating on ideas — a sibling feature to the asset-audit workflow covered on 7/07, this one focused on AI-driven scene assembly inside the editor.
